title: Rider Loyalty Terms: Trip-Volume Goodwill on Cleaning and Damage Fees Repair Charges
content:
**Rule.** The trip-volume goodwill percentage of a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage fee approved at review is read from the rider's trip fare charges whose charge date lies fewer than six whole calendar months before the approval date: a count at or above the high-volume trip count takes the high-volume percentage; a count from the mid-volume trip count up to one less than the high-volume trip count takes the mid-volume percentage; a lower count takes no trip-volume goodwill.

| Rider's trip fare charges in the window | Trip-volume goodwill |
|---|---|
| 6 or more (high volume) | 5% |
| 2 to 5 (mid volume) | 3% |
| 0 or 1 | none |

- **What is counted.** The rider's trip fare charge entries in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares); other trip charges — tips, cancellation or no-show fees, wait time, tolls, surcharges, adjustments or refunds — are not fare charges and are not counted.
- **The window.** A fare charge counts when its charge date lies fewer than six whole calendar months before the approval date. A charge dated exactly six whole months before the approval date does not count.

The percentage reduces the fee as it stands immediately before the final rounding, after the fee has been held to its ceiling; the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Window cases (hypothetical; approval on 11 October 2026)

| Fare charge date | Whole months before the approval date | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| 12 April 2026 | 5 | yes |
| 11 April 2026 | 6 | no |
| 30 September 2026 | 0 | yes |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A damage fee standing at $725.00 immediately before the final rounding, with 6 fare charges in the window: $725.00 reduced by 5%, that is $688.75.
